scope: Entire v1 exploration is excluded from the semantic oracle. NtQuerySection incorrectly declared its ReturnLength pointer as PULONG instead of PSIZE_T, allowing an8-byte native64 return into a4-byte local. NtQueryObject also used an oversized fixed64-byte basic-information query and obtained STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH. Re-run v2 uses separate exact native prototypes and56-byte object-basic length.
